# Example harness reference — fixture

A stand-in for a real harness reference: only the driver token matters. The red
tree (testdata/plugintree/unresolved) and the neutral tree
(testdata/plugintree/neutral) hold this file byte-for-byte identically except for
the token in the three driver positions below, so the pass/fail difference
between the two trees is attributable to that token and to nothing else.

Target set is **both surfaces, headless-first** (human:<name>,
2026-08-26): the headless CLI is the primary surface, the in-editor agent the
secondary one. The date sits on the next line on purpose — a wrapped attribution
is the shape that first escaped the skill-body-only lint.

The live smoke is the stream's external head, human:<name>'s.

Role window, no persona; driver human:<name>; the human decides and merges.

## Legitimate capitalised words that must NOT be reported

Cursor's matrix, GitHub's API, Claude Code's hooks, the App's identity, track
B's search before track A's filing, and a rule id (R6, 2026-07-10) are all fine:
a product, a platform, a project noun, a label and an acronym are not house
values.
